handedness.visual_basis: Lead (left) side is closer to target at address; golfer's left hip and chest nearer the target in DTL setup frames (e.g. tick 15).

temporal_orientation.visual_basis: Golfer at address with club behind ball, no visible motion
Hands and club are leaving the ball; club shaft moving up and away from address
Continuation of takeaway; hands and club further away from ball
Hands higher and club continuing away from ball
Mid backswing; hands rising away from ball
Hands and club further on backswing, rising above address height
Late backswing; hands high and behind torso
Near top of backswing; hands high and club up
Hands near top and starting to change direction (slight transition visible)
Club has begun downmoving toward the ball; hands and shaft moving down
Downswing continuing; hands approaching ball plane
Hands continuing toward the ball; club approaching strike area
Follow-through with hands past impact area and torso turned toward target
Continuation of follow-through; club well past ball
Late follow-through; torso turned, club high
Finish pose; club over shoulder and body rotated toward target
